thread:
sam: Heads-up — regen diff CI is failing on the sampleapp onboarding flow after the openapi change. Seeing semver bump noise in the client SDKs.

jess: Ugh. Which SDKs?

sam: Go + TS. The openapi typegen reordered some optional props, so the TS client has a minor API surface change. CircleCI shows a diff in type hashes.

mike: Is it actually a breaking change or just doc ordering? We shouldn't bump semver for ordering-only diffs.

sam: It's ordering of generated ts types and default param order changed for one helper fn — some sample tests assert exact codegen output, so CI fails.

tina: Can we relax the sampleapp tests to ignore whitespace/ordering? Or use a stable-sort flag in the generator?

sam: Tried stable-sort=true locally but still get var reorder inside interface comments. The typegen hash stage flags it as a regen-diff.

jess: Also noticed auth/retry parity issues — python SDK's retry backoff got a small patch in #3421 that TS doesn't have. That test is failing in the sampleapp auth flow. Might be two unrelated diffs colliding.

olivia: @sam can you paste the failing CI snippet?

sam: Sure:```
Error: regen-diff detected in packages/clients/ts/src/generated/sample.ts\Expected hash: 0x7a3f\Actual hash: 0x7b02\See: tools/typegen/hash-report --path packages/clients/ts
```

mike: Seems like two problems: (1) hash drift from ordering, (2) missing auth retry parity. Recommend: split into two PRs so we can get the ordering fix non-breaking, and land retry parity separately.

jess: Agreed. Splitting helps releases. But splitting will still block the sampleapp e2e until both land, unless we pin the sampleapp to the previous generated artifact.

tina: We could pin the sampleapp onboarding repo to a specific generated client commit in CI (temporary). Not ideal but fast.

sam: I'm worried about semver mechanics — if we publish a patch to TS to fix ordering without changing runtime behavior, semver should be patch. But typegen currently marks a change in the generated surface as "minor" if property ordering changed. That's the generator's semver diff heuristic.

jess: That heuristic is what caused the last publish bump that confused ops. Can we update the semver heuristic to ignore deterministic ordering-only changes (comments, jsdoc, property order) unless they change optional->required or type shape?

mike: Yes, we can. It's a change to the semver rule set in tools/typegen/semver-check. Low-risk but needs tests.

dev-bot: CI update: build 4871 failed on regen-diff check (see https://circleci.com/gh/redwood-inference/clients/4871) :x:

olivia: For immediate unblock: Sam please open a patch PR that pins sampleapp CI to generated-commit abc123 and include a link to the split PRs for the actual fixes. We'll ship the pin as a hotfix to get the onboarding pipelines green.

sam: Will do. PRs: (A) regen-stable-sort-hotfix (B) ts-auth-retry-parity.

jess: For the long term: add a unit test in typegen that verifies semver-decision doesn't flip for reorders. Also add a sampleapp onboarding e2e that runs against both pinned and latest generated clients to detect regressions early.

tina: I'll draft the test for semver-ignore-ordering. Mike can you review?

mike: Yep. Also suggest adding a lint job that computes the typegen hash before and after openapi formatting to catch formatting-induced diffs in PRs.

sam: Thanks — I'll open the pin PR now and add notes to the sampleapp onboarding README about pinning clients during generator churn.

jess: :thumbsup:

olivia: One more ask — can we add a small blurb to the developer onboarding docs about how to run `tools/typegen/hash-report` and interpret regen diffs? New hires keep getting surprised.

sam: Good idea. I'll add a short section under dev-experience/tooling.

mike: ok let's track action items: 1) sam: open pin PR (hotfix) 2) sam: open regen-stable-sort-hotfix PR 3) sam: open ts-auth-retry-parity PR 4) tina/mike: semver-ignore-ordering test + lint job 5) jess/olivia: docs blurb.

jess: I'll follow up on the docs.

sam: Done — pin PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapp/pull/278 (temporary pin). I'll post PRs for the two fixes shortly.

tina: Thanks. I'll start the semver test skeleton.

mike: Great. Re-run CI after pin lands.

sam: End of thread — updating ticket INF-1123 with links.
